'''Franklyn Green Jenifer''' (born March 26, 1939, in Washington, D.C.) is a former academic administrator, researcher, trustee, and board member of a number of well-known institutions and companies.

== Biography ==
Franklyn Jenifer is an alumnus of [[Howard University]],<ref name="fdu.edu">{{cite web|url=http://inside.fdu.edu/prpt/jenifer_bot_2011.html|title=Recent Press Releases :: Fairleigh Dickinson University (FDU)|website=inside.fdu.edu}}</ref> and received a doctorate in plant virology from the [[University of Maryland]].<ref>{{cite news|title=The Continuing Education of Franklyn Jenifer|author=Williams, Juan|newspaper=The Washington Post|date=Sep 20, 1992|page=N9}}</ref>

Jenifer was elected to serve on the board of trustees for [[Fairleigh Dickinson University]].<ref name="fdu.edu"/> in 2011. He has been re-elected twice, with his current term scheduled to expire in 2020.
 
He held the role of President of the [[University of Texas at Dallas]] (1994–2005), and President of Howard University (1990–1994). He was the first graduate of Howard University to become its head.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.howard.edu/explore/history.htm |title=Redirect - History - Howard University |access-date=2014-03-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151005202423/http://www.howard.edu/explore/history.htm |archive-date=2015-10-05 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Jenifer was Provost at the Rutgers Newark Campus,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.silobreaker.com/biography-for-franklyn-jenifer-5_2258958573570621440_4|title=Cyber Threat Intelligence|website=Silobreaker|access-date=2014-03-05|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140308040416/http://news.silobreaker.com/biography-for-franklyn-jenifer-5_2258958573570621440_4|archive-date=2014-03-08|url-status=dead}}</ref> Chancellor of the Massachusetts Board of Regents of Higher Education (1986–1990) and Vice Chancellor of the New Jersey Department of Higher Education (1979–1986).<ref name="forbes">{{cite news |title=Franklyn Jenifer |url=https://www.forbes.com/profile/franklyn-jenifer/ |archive-url=https://archive.today/20140305010145/http://www.forbes.com/profile/franklyn-jenifer/ |archive-date=2014-03-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.answers.com/topic/franklyn-g-jenifer|title=Answers – The Most Trusted Place for Answering Life's Questions|website=Answers.com}}</ref>

He has also served as chairman for the National Council on Science and Technology Education for Project 2061 of the American Association for the Advancement of Science<ref>{{cite news|title=Benchmarks for Science Literacy American Association for the Advancement of Science, Oxford University Press, Nov 25, 1993 – Science – 448 pages (in preface)}}</ref> |and has served on the board of directors at Texaco and Chevron.<ref name="forbes" /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.chevron.com/about/leadership/boardofdirectors/jenifer/|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110213203701/http://www.chevron.com/about/leadership/boardofdirectors/jenifer/|archivedate=2011-02-13|title=Franklyn G. Jenifer – About Chevron|date=13 February 2011|publisher=Chevron}}</ref><ref>{{cite news| url=http://data.huffingtonpost.com/paypals/franklyn-g-jenifer | work=Huffington Post | title=Franklyn G.
